draft.subject: Your notification badge ticket + first project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge issue — your ticket is still open on our side and I'll keep you posted as we work it.

In the meantime, the one thing that makes week one worthwhile is getting a real project set up: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Chidi
